title: Rory and the Velvet Clover Bed
verses:
The sun slipped away in the west,
The valley was quiet and deep,
And Rory was ready to rest,
And dream in a beautiful sleep.

Then Benny walked over the hill,
And Tilly lay down on the ground,
The breeze was so gentle and still,
With barely a rustling sound.

Now Ricky was ready to hide,
While Nia flew down from the sky,
They snuggled up close side-by-side,
As soft little clouds drifted by.

Psittaco was tucked in a nest,
To sleep through the cool of the night,
He settled his chin on his chest,
Beneath the pale silvery light.

The stars were beginning to glow,
And shine on the sleepy green lawn,
The river was steady and slow,
To carry them into the dawn.

So Rory closed both of his eyes,
With all of his friends in a ring,
Beneath the dark, beautiful skies,
To hear what the quiet would bring.
